drawings.name: line_cabinet_tower
drawings.refnote: The attached images are style references only (line drawings made earlier for this series, black ink on white): match their line weight, pen feel and level of detail exactly. The first one is the series' library card-catalogue cabinet: the cabinets in this picture are the same kind of furniture, drawn the same way, but do not copy the picture.
drawings.prompt: Two old wooden library card-catalogue cabinets standing side by side on the floor, front view. On the left, a small squat cabinet about knee height with a few rows of small drawers (about 4 columns by 3 rows). On the right, an enormous cabinet of the same kind that towers up almost to the top of the picture, with a dense grid of many tiny identical drawers (about 10 columns by 22 rows), each with a tiny round pull and a blank label plate; a wooden rolling library ladder leans against the tall cabinet. Portrait image 1024x1536; the two cabinets together fill about 85% of the width; the tall one fills about 90% of the height. All label plates are blank.

drawings.name: line_drawer_ribbon
drawings.refnote: The attached images are style references only (line drawings made earlier for this series, black ink on white): match their line weight, pen feel and level of detail exactly, but do not copy their content.
drawings.prompt: A single long wooden drawer from a library card catalogue, pulled completely out and floating in the upper part of the picture, seen from a three-quarter view from above, with its small round pull and blank label plate at the front. Out of the open drawer rises one very long blank paper tape, like an adding-machine roll or a ticker tape, that unrolls over the drawer's edge and falls all the way down the picture in long smooth loops and S-curves, piling up in a few coils at the bottom. Portrait image 1024x1536; the drawer fills about 60% of the width at the top, the tape runs down about 85% of the height. The tape is completely blank.

drawings.name: line_clerk_ladder
drawings.prompt: An invented, cheerful but tired clerk character (simple round face, dot eyes, short hair, sleeves rolled up, a pencil behind the ear) standing near the top of a tall wooden rolling library ladder, holding a clipboard and making a tick with a pencil, in front of an enormous wall of tiny identical card-catalogue drawers that fills the background from edge to edge (many rows and columns, each with a tiny pull and a blank label). A small drop of sweat on the forehead. Portrait image 1024x1536; the ladder and clerk fill about 45% of the width in the centre, the wall of drawers fills the whole picture behind them. All labels and the clipboard are blank.

drawings.name: line_dusty_drawer
drawings.prompt: A close-up of the front of a library card-catalogue cabinet, a grid of 3 by 3 drawers. The middle drawer is the only one never used: thick cobwebs stretch across its front from corner to corner, a small friendly spider hangs from a thread, little puffs of dust sit on its pull. The eight drawers around it look well used: their pulls are rubbed and a couple of them stand slightly open with blank index cards sticking out. Square image 1024x1024; the grid fills about 85% of the width, centred. All label plates and cards are blank.

drawings.name: line_postal_scale
drawings.prompt: An invented student character (simple round face, dot eyes, short hair, hoodie) standing at a small table at home, carefully placing a thick stack of loose paper pages onto an old-fashioned kitchen or postal scale with a round dial and a needle; the dial face is blank, no numbers. On the table beside the scale lie a large empty envelope and a pencil. The student looks at the dial, concentrating. Square image 1024x1024; the character, table and scale fill about 85% of the width. All pages, the envelope and the dial are blank.

drawings.name: line_scissors_strips
drawings.prompt: Seen from above on a table: a stapled research paper of several pages, its last pages cut with a pair of scissors into many long horizontal paper strips that lie side by side in neat rows across the table; the scissors lie open next to them. One hand at the right lifts exactly three of the strips up off the table between its fingers. Landscape image 1536x1024; the paper, the strips and the hand fill about 90% of the width. The pages and strips show only plain lines suggesting text, never letters or numbers.
